name: Cambay Shahbandar
role: Gujarati shahbandar, personal name unrecorded here
bio: He raises the Cambay merchants’ objections when Portuguese ships seek entry. A captain can seek his help without speaking with his voice.
notes: fact: Araújo’s report in Birch links the unnamed Gujarati shahbandar to opposition to Portuguese entry; Pires describes the office and its constituency (Birch III, p. 70; Pires II, p. 265)
inference: The sources do not establish that he was also the Gujarati captain of either reported episode (Pires II, pp. 257, 279; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: The display title preserves anonymity; dealings with the fictional merchant roster are invented (people-factions.md §4)
